name: ai-talk
description: AI Talk preserves development task state, escalates safeguards with risk, and enforces explicit write boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Preserve task state and escalate safeguards with risk
interface.longDescription: AI Talk preserves goals, authorization, scope, evidence, and verification across development turns. Clear local work stays on the lightweight Fast Path; real ambiguity, cross-module behavior, bounded scope, or external mutations progressively activate RequirementContract 1.4. Internal reasoning stays private, while material target binding, diagnostic, boundary, escalation, and state-reuse decisions become visible as compact evidence-backed summaries and terminal contributions.
capabilities: Silent internal reasoning with visible material decisions
Transparent pass-through for status and ordinary confirmation messages
No-contract Fast Path for clear local work
Runtime Fast Path escalation before expanded writes
Zero reference and reporter calls on Fast Path
Deterministic contract schema and reference validation
Progressive protocol loading for complex work
Explicit excluded scope and bounded write policy
Direct or exact-proposal authorization for external writes
Exact external authorization continuity without scope expansion
Separated staged, unstaged, untracked, and stash state
Log evidence without implicit scope expansion
Stable selector and DOM fingerprint capture
Entry point and control point separation
Live browser evidence for UI failures
DOM, geometry, occlusion, and resource inspection
